meta.data_source: Real XAUUSD (Dukascopy) 2022–2026. Walk-forward variants are true out-of-sample; single-window variants run on the same real data.

variants.label: ★ Regime-Aware Switch (walk-forward)
variants.desc: Trend-follow in trends, mean-revert/stand-aside in ranges. Walk-forward OOS: params re-selected on each 12mo train window, tested on the next 3mo. NOTE: ~69% of profit is from the 2026 Q1 parabolic spike — real edge but tail-driven (trend-following positive skew).

variants.label: Trend-Following (walk-forward)
variants.desc: Donchian / MA-momentum riding with the trend, ATR trailing stop. Walk-forward OOS across all 2022–2026 regimes.
